name: Pinned chapters
look: A process section holds one screen of scroll while its steps open on the left. A frame taking 55 to 60 percent of the container crossfades between their photographs or UI views.
reduced: Nothing is pinned: from 640px each step is a static row, its text at the left and its visual at the right (at most 30svh tall); on a phone each step stands with its 16:9 visual under it. Two to four steps fit two screens at 1440x900, 1024x768, 820x1180 and 390x844.
phone: A lighter version on a phone, nothing pinned: each step stands with its title, two lines and its visual under it; the step crossing the middle of the screen takes the accent rule at its left, and each picture settles from a close crop to its framing as it rises.

needs.words: 2 to 4 steps, a title and two lines each
needs.pictures: one picture or screen per step
